units: <cite ref="Berakhot 31a:5">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אין … לא מתוך ע׳ וכ׳</he> you must not rise for prayer in a mood of grief or in languor … but in religious joy.
<cite ref="Pesachim 117a:13">Pes. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>אין השכינה … מתוך ע׳ וכ׳</he> the Divine Presence (holy inspiration) does not rest upon man in moments of languor or sadness &c.

<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:11">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>אין עצי׳ לפני וכ׳</he> there is no sadness before the Lord, for it is written (<cite ref="I Chronicles 16:27">I Chr. XVI, 27</cite>) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 292">Yalk. Jer. 292</cite>.
